subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose blocked Telegram and WhatsApp DM content through a message_pre_auth plugin/internal hook and automatically activate trusted access-request handlers for existing allowlist configurations?
rationale: Tests and live proof can verify mechanics, but they cannot decide whether pre-admission content exposure, a new permanent plugin API, and implicit trusted-hook activation are acceptable product and security policy.

options.title: Approve After Contract Repair
options.body: Accept the bounded trusted-hook design after the branch reuses the canonical access-group contract and documents the upgrade and activation behavior.

options.title: Split The Feature
options.body: Separate the observation hook, grouped allowlists, automatic handler loading, and workspace example into narrower review and rollback units.

options.title: Pause The Direction
options.body: Keep existing silent blocking and close or park this PR if maintainers do not want a core pre-auth observation surface.

recommendation.title: Approve After Contract Repair
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded trusted-hook design after the branch reuses the canonical access-group contract and documents the upgrade and activation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the shared channel ingress, allowlist mutation, and plugin SDK boundaries involved in this decision.
